name: session-topic
description: Two-line banner above the prompt naming what this session is about; Haiku keeps it current as the subject changes

enabled.title: On by default
enabled.description: Show the topic banner when a session starts. /topic on and /topic off override it for one session.

view.title: Where to show it
view.description: band is the strip above the prompt; pane is a side pane (a sidebar in fullscreen). /topic band and /topic pane switch it for one session.

color.title: Colour
color.description: Colour of the banner, taken from your theme. none draws plain bold and italic text.

band_chars.title: Band length (characters per line)
band_chars.description: Approximate characters per line for the band above the prompt. A line wider than the terminal is cut anyway.

pane_chars.title: Pane length (characters of focus text)
pane_chars.description: Approximate characters for the second line when the topic is shown in a pane (/topic pane), which has room for a short paragraph.
